checkpointPayload.title: Smart Gathering: Graceful fallback and auto-recovery on MarchLimitExceeded rejection

taskChanges.newValue:
1. Update SmartGatherState in src/types/game/gatherQueue.ts to include optional marchLimitBackoffUntil
2. Update sync in src/services/queues/smartGather.ts to handle MarchLimitExceeded as non-fatal with notice/backoff and auto-heal existing stuck states
3. Update planAutoGather in src/services/queues/autoGather.ts to check marchLimitBackoffUntil and wait for squads to return
4. Update backgroundRuntime.ts to trigger getMarches and getUnitSummary refresh when MarchLimitExceeded is encountered
5. Add automated unit tests in tests/smart-gather-march-limit.test.mjs covering MarchLimitExceeded rejection, auto-healing, and autoGather waiting
6. Run full test suite and build verification
